main_body: Flat 4x3-tile farm ground patch: wheat rows at the top, a green crop hedge band in the middle, and tilled soil furrows with sprouts at the bottom
top_band: none; this is a ground surface, not a standing object. Column read: gold wheat, then brown, then gold wheat, then green crops, then dark soil, then brown furrows
evidence: Terrain tile set with horizontal bands of crop and soil texture. There is no standing volume, no vertical face and no isometric side face, so the 3/4 top-plus-front contract does not apply. It reads as a ground patch seen from above at an angle, which is acceptable for the terrain kind.

style.evidence: Wheat uses about 5 tones (cream highlights, yellow, orange, brown). Soil uses 4-5 browns with lighter clods and dark furrows. Crops use 4 greens in clumps with sprout highlights. The dark edges are tinted brown or green beside the matching material, not neutral black. No large flat fills: every area carries speckle, grain or tuft variation. Tile density is at least as rich as the plain grass and paving references.
